connector.name: Contractor License Verification (TradesAPI)
connector.registryDescription: Verify contractor licenses: 50 states + DC + 8 cities - status, expiration, disciplinary history.
connector.summary: Hosted at tradesapi.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package contractor-license-mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the noquarter6 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
